name: rust
label: Rust

panel.describes: the bottom-right corner (health, food and water bars)

hints: Rust: there is no kill feed. A headshot has a distinct sharp hit sound and the target drops fast; listen for it. Scientists, bears, wolves and other NPCs or animals count as npc_or_bot. Long-range bow, crossbow or bolt-action headshots are hard. Holding off several attackers at a base, or winning a fight against a group alone, is outnumbered. round_decisive means the fight decided a raid or base defense.
